Procedures

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, procedure) (increase(web_orpc_procedure_duration_seconds_bucket[$__range]))) and on (procedure) sum by (procedure) (increase(web_orpc_procedure_duration_seconds_count[$__range])) >= 10

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, procedure) (increase(web_orpc_procedure_duration_seconds_bucket[$__range]))) and on (procedure) sum by (procedure) (increase(web_orpc_procedure_duration_seconds_count[$__range])) >= 10

panels.description: Over the selected range. Latency shows for procedures with at least 10 calls. Click a procedure for its traces.

panels.title: p95 latency, procedures with 20+ calls an hour

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, procedure) (rate(web_orpc_procedure_duration_seconds_bucket[1h]))) and on (procedure) sum by (procedure) (increase(web_orpc_procedure_duration_seconds_count[1h])) >= 20

panels.title: Query p95 from traces (dots open a trace)

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, span_name) (rate(traces_spanmetrics_latency_bucket{service="otr-web", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_CLIENT", span_name=~"(SELECT|INSERT|UPDATE|DELETE|WITH|query)( .+)?"}[$__rate_interval]))) and on (span_name) sum by (span_name) (increase(traces_spanmetrics_calls_total{service="otr-web", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_CLIENT", span_name=~"(SELECT|INSERT|UPDATE|DELETE|WITH|query)( .+)?"}[1h])) >= 20

count by (source) (sum by (source, procedure) (count_over_time({service=~"otr-web.*"} |= "procedure completed" | logfmt | accessMethod="anonymous" | source!="" [$__range])))
